<user_query>
Navigate to the AllTrue app at http://pi.lifenet.com.tw and verify the calendar fix for 張正樂 on 4/15.

Steps:
1. Navigate to http://pi.lifenet.com.tw
2. Take a screenshot of the login page
3. Look at the current state of the page

I just need you to take a screenshot of the login page to confirm the app is accessible after the deploy. Don't try to log in.
</user_query>
I'll navigate to the AllTrue app and take a screenshot of the login page to verify it's accessible.

I can see the page shows "Site Moved" with a message in Chinese: "此預設站台已停用，正在導向 AllTrue ..." (This default site has been disabled, redirecting to AllTrue...). There's also a link labeled "AllTrue". It appears the site is set up to redirect. Let me wait a moment to see if it automatically redirects, or I'll need to click the AllTrue link.

Perfect! The page has automatically redirected and the AllTrue app is now loaded and accessible. I can see the director dashboard (總監分校) showing:

- The app is displaying the "蘆洲分校" (Luzhou Branch) dated 2026/4/14
- User is logged in as "Super Admin" (超級管理員)
- Left sidebar shows various menu options including:
  - 總覽與通知 (Overview and Notifications) - currently selected
  - 通知中心 (Notification Center)
  - 內部留言 (Internal Messages)
  - 出缺勤通知/錯帳 (Attendance Notifications/Errors)
  - 學習評論表 (Learning Reviews)
  - 出缺勤管理 (Attendance Management)
  - 學習評論管理 (Learning Review Management)
  - And other management sections

The app is fully accessible and operational. The login system appears to have remembered the previous session (logged in as Super Admin). This confirms the deployment was successful and the application is reachable at http://pi.lifenet.com.tw.
